for a symbol with storage 0x87c3 (GL_LOCAL_CONSTANT_EXT): counts it in the program state (+0x118, +0x4c) and finds free constant register slots (one for a vector 0x87bf, four for a matrix 0x87c0), growing the slot pool by 0x40 entries when full

for a symbol with storage 0x87c4 (GL_LOCAL_EXT) not yet allocated (+0x3d): marks it, counts it and allocates temp register slots (scalar, vector, matrix rows) from the 0x28-byte pool, growing it by 0x40
for a type-2 (symbol) source operand: walks the symbol and its aliases (+0x30/+0x34) and calls evsAllocLocalConstantRegisters for each until one succeeds

emits the IL words of the fog output: IL mov (0x47) to the fog register (ctx+0x13c0 index | 0x440000) and, depending on the fog mode word at engine state +0x2e04 (0x801 GL_EXP2, 0x2601 GL_LINEAR, 0x800 GL_EXP), the extra ops that compute the fog factor; param_4 == 0 selects the plain copy

counterpart of extvsAssignVertexInputs for the IL path: for each source operand of type 2 whose symbol is an unbound VARIANT (0x87c1) it hands out input register slots (0x28-byte slots, 4 per matrix) and, for state-bound symbols, switches on the state kind 0..0x10 to set the attribute-used flags and register numbers (position, normal, colour, secondary colour, fog, texcoords ...) in the program state
(table, id): looks up a program state by id in the 32 hash buckets at table+4 (bucket id & 0x1f), following the chain link at state+0x138 and comparing the id at state+0x38
computes the id of the current program state (FUN_00076ac0), stores it at +0x38, links the state into its hash bucket (chain at +0x138), sets +0x134 and counts it in table[0x21]

frees a program state object: its hardware program (ctx hook +0x12ac when the program at +0x13c is built), the arrays at +8, +0x10, +0x3c, +0x44, +0x114, +0x11c, +0x13d8, +0x124 and the object itself; clears the current-state pointer ctx+0x148c if it pointed inside it

walks the state tables (current table index ctx+0x118c, or all tables of the shader table at ctx+0x116c) and frees every program state whose +0x134 flag is clear (vpStateFree), including the entries chained in the hash buckets

(ctx, table, entry): copies the 4 floats of entry+0x38 into the state's constant array slot (state+0x154 + 0x10*entry[1]), tracks the highest slot index (+0x137c) and flags the context dirty (ctx+0x38 |= 0x1000, ctx+0x2d |= 1, ctx+0x29 = 1)
